description: Full-text search over tagged XBRL note/footnote text blocks — the disclosure prose behind the numbers (hedge notionals, commitment schedules, related-party narrative) that companyfacts/frames never expose. Give a search phrase; optionally narrow to one company or one note tag. This searches tagged NOTE BLOCKS only, not full filing text — for phrase search over the whole filing document use edgar_filing_text instead.

company.description: Optional company name (ILIKE) to restrict the search to one filer.

query.description: Search phrase, e.g. "cross-currency interest rate swap notional".

tag.description: Optional exact note tag to restrict to, e.g. "DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgingActivitiesDisclosureTextBlock".

name: note_text_search
title: Note Text Search
